items.title: Is Canada about to join the EU?
items.description: Ties between Canada and the European Union have been getting closer as trade dispute with the US continue.

items.title: Russia votes for new parliament in controlled elections
items.description: Russia is holding elections for the State Duma for the first time since Moscow sent troops into Ukraine in 2022. The party of President Vladimir Putin is expected to win the highly controlled affair.

items.title: A war-fatigued and anxious Russia picks a new parliament
items.description: Fuel shortages, drone strikes and mobilization rumors are fueling anxiety and war fatigue in Russia. As support for peace talks grows among Russians, the Kremlin is watching closely ahead of parliamentary elections.
